Module org.egothor.radixor
Package org.egothor.stemmer

Class StemmerModelRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.egothor.stemmer.StemmerModelRegistry
public final class StemmerModelRegistry extends Object
Immutable deterministic registry of models discovered from classpath indexes.

Discovery enumerates every "META-INF/radixor/models.index" visible to the selected class loader, validates the referenced descriptors, sorts them by stable model identifier, and rejects duplicate identifiers. Selection never depends on classpath order. Registry creation validates metadata and resource presence; StemmerPatchTrieLoader verifies resource bytes when loading a model.

Registry creation is not globally cached. Applications should normally discover once for a class-loader scope and retain the immutable result.

  • Method Details

    • fromContextClassLoader

      public static StemmerModelRegistry fromContextClassLoader() throws IOException
      Discovers models through the current thread context class loader.

      If the context loader is null, the defining class loader of this registry is used.

      Returns:
      immutable registry in stable model-ID order
      Throws:
      IOException - if index or descriptor resources cannot be enumerated or read
      DuplicateStemmerModelException - if two descriptors declare one model ID
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if an index, descriptor, or declared resource is invalid
      UnsupportedStemmerModelFormatException - if a descriptor uses an unsupported format

    • fromClassLoader

      public static StemmerModelRegistry fromClassLoader(ClassLoader classLoader) throws IOException
      Discovers and validates every indexed descriptor visible to an explicit class loader.
      Parameters:
      classLoader - class loader whose indexed model resources are visible
      Returns:
      immutable registry in stable model-ID order
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if classLoader is null
      IOException - if index or descriptor resources cannot be enumerated or read
      DuplicateStemmerModelException - if two descriptors declare one model ID
      StemmerModelIntegrityException - if an index, descriptor, or declared resource is invalid
      UnsupportedStemmerModelFormatException - if a descriptor uses an unsupported format
